newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Res Beijing Land IPO 100x subscribed - source.
newsitem.headline: China Res Beijing Land IPO 100x subscribed - source.

text.p: The Hong Kong offer of shares in China Resources Beijing Land Ltd, the China property unit spun off by China Resources Enterprise Ltd, was seen to be over 100 times subscribed at the close of application on Friday, market sources said.
The shares' price was expected to be fixed at top end the expected range at HK$2.36 per share, they said.

Beijing Land offered 300 million shares at a price ranging HK$2.18 to HK$2.36 per share. It said 15 percent of the issue was for public subscription in Hong Kong and 85 percent for international placement.
An official statement on the subscription results is due to be released on November 6. Dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin on November 8.
